risks.risk: Processor is not 12th Gen Intel Core i7
risks.proof: Photo of system information screen (e.g., Windows About or CPU-Z) showing exact processor model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lower-generation or non-i7 processor, which reduces value.

risks.proof: Photo of system information screen showing GPU details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having integrated graphics of unknown type, which may be less valuable.

risks.risk: Laptop has hidden physical damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Full 360-degree video or photos showing all edges, hinges, ports, and underside.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged or worn, reducing value.

risks.risk: Battery health is poor or not included

risks.if_unproven: Priced as battery not working or degraded, which reduces value.
